## Summary

Describe the engineering problem or change. Link the corresponding task proposal or issue.

Closes #

## Scope

- [ ] New task
- [ ] Existing task fix
- [ ] Documentation or tooling

## Task verification (for task PRs)

- [ ] Instructions state design objectives, constraints, and final artifact
- [ ] Reference design passes all validity checks
- [ ] Reference objective was independently reproduced
- [ ] Invalid or malformed submissions were tested
- [ ] Solver version, dependencies, licensing, and resource needs documented
- [ ] End-to-end agent run completed and results recorded
- [ ] Agent/evaluator isolation reviewed
- [ ] Engineering targets distinguished from validity checks

## Evidence

List exact commands run, software versions, relevant logs, evaluation outputs, and known limitations.

## Reviewer notes

What physical assumptions, numerical tolerances, or evaluator choices deserve close inspection?

**Note:** Merging a task does not automatically add it to an official benchmark release or leaderboard.
